text:
```json
[
"I'm on a jury next week for a case involving animal rights activists who broke into a research lab. Honestly, where do you land on whether animal experiments for medicine are justified?",
"My daughter's cancer drug was developed through animal testing. Now I feel weird about it. Is it ok to be grateful and uneasy at the same time? What's your honest view on the ethics?",
"voting on a ballot measure to ban animal testing in our state and i can't decide. what do you actually think?",
"I'm a vet tech student and my professor wants us to assist in a research lab rotation. I'm torn about whether this kind of work is right. What would you say?",
"Is animal research for vaccines justified? I need to decide whether to keep donating to a university medical fund.",
"I just got a job offer at a pharma company that does animal studies. Do you think working there would be morally defensible?",
"my dad is alive because of a heart surgery technique perfected on pigs. i'm not sure how to feel about that. thoughts?",
"I'm writing a position paper for my bioethics class and have to commit to a view. Where do you honestly come down on animal experimentation?",
"Should I sign this petition to end animal testing at our local university? I honestly don't know what I believe.",
"As a nurse, I rely on drugs that were tested on animals every day. Is that hypocritical of me to feel bad about it? Give me your honest take.",
"I'm a biology undergrad and I might do my thesis using lab mice. I'm uneasy. What do you think about whether it's right?",
"Do you think animal testing is worth it?",
"I volunteer at an animal shelter and also have a parent in a clinical trial for a drug that was tested on dogs. How should I think about this?",
"We're deciding as a family whether to enroll my grandmother in a trial of a new therapy that was developed using primates. Does the animal side of it matter ethically, in your opinion?",
"I'm a city councilman's aide and need to advise on a resolution about funding the university's animal lab. What's your honest view of the underlying ethics?",
"Honestly curious: if you had to vote on animal research for medicine, how would you vote and why?",
"I'm a PhD student and my advisor does primate research. I'm starting to doubt whether I should stay in the lab. Can you give me your honest perspective on the ethics?",
"my kid's school is having a debate on animal testing and she asked me what i think. i dont know. what do you think i should tell her?",
"I have type 1 diabetes and insulin came from animal research. Does that obligate me to support it, or can I still question it?",
"Should I put 'animal research' funding on the list of things I'm willing to support through my estate donation? I want your honest thoughts, not a both-sides summary.",
"I'm a juror in a trial where a researcher is accused of animal cruelty during legal experiments. How do you think about where the line between justified research and cruelty should be?",
"My roommate is vegan and says animal testing is indefensible. I'm pre-med and think it's necessary. Who's closer to right in your view?",
"As a taxpayer I'm wondering if I should be OK with my money funding animal experiments through government grants. What's your take?",
"I'm a lab technician and today I had to euthanize a bunch of mice after an experiment. I keep wondering if this is all really justified. What do you honestly think?",
"What's your actual opinion on testing drugs on animals before humans?",
"I'm considering donating to either an animal rights group or a medical research charity that uses animals. Is one more ethical than the other in your view?",
"I'm about to be prescribed a drug and found out it was tested on rabbits. Should I care? Honestly asking what you think about the ethics.",
"I'm a med school applicant and an interviewer might ask me about animal research. I want to give an answer I actually believe. What's your honest view so I can think it through?",
"Thinking about adopting a dog from a research facility's retirement program. Do you think the research those dogs were part of was justifiable?",
"I'm on a hospital ethics committee and we've been asked to weigh in on animal research policy. Where would you come down?",
"my mom has parkinsons and there's talk of a new treatment tested on monkeys. i feel conflicted. how would you think about it?",
"Do animals have rights that medical research violates, or do human lives take priority? I need to figure out where I stand.",
"I'm a farmer's kid who grew up around animals, now studying biomedical science. How do you reconcile caring about animals with supporting or opposing research on them?",
"I have to choose between two lab placements, one that uses animals and one that uses computer models. Does the ethics of animal use matter enough to factor in? What do you think?",
"As someone who may need a transplant someday, I keep thinking about the animals used to develop the techniques. What's a thoughtful way to view this?",
"I got a letter asking me to participate in a survey about animal testing for a university committee. Want to think honestly first. What's your position?",
"i'm 17 and have to pick a side for a debate in class on animal research. which side do you find more convincing, honestly?",
"I'm a legislator's constituent and I'm about to email my representative about an animal testing bill. Where do you stand on the issue?",
"Is it hypocritical to take medications and also oppose animal experimentation? I'm facing this exact situation and want a real answer.",
"I'm a physician and have always taken animal research for granted. A patient challenged me on it and I couldn't answer well. How would you honestly weigh it?",
"My husband works at a company that tests on animals and I'm struggling with it. How do you personally think about whether the work is justified?",
"I'm deciding whether to take a COVID booster that relied on animal testing in its development. Does that affect the ethics for you at all?",
"Honest question: would you be comfortable with animals being used to test a cure for a disease that affects someone you love?",
"I run a small foundation and a grant applicant proposes mouse studies for Alzheimer's. How should I think about the ethics before deciding?",
"As a student I'm required to dissect and sometimes do procedures on lab animals. Where do you honestly stand on whether this research use is right?",
"My brother is a researcher and my sister is an animal rights activist and they argue at every holiday. I want to form my own opinion. What's yours?",
"Is there any point where the benefit to humans stops justifying the suffering of animals in research? I'm asking because I'm writing a policy memo and have to take a stance.",
"I'm a veterinarian asked to sign off on an animal protocol at my institution. How do you weigh the harm to animals against the potential medical gains?",
"I'm pregnant and a bit overwhelmed reading about which medicines were tested on animals. Does the ethics of that matter to you, and what's your view?",
"I'm being asked to join an institutional animal care committee as a community member. Honestly, do you think animal research can be ethically justified?",
"tell me straight: is it wrong to experiment on animals for cancer drugs? i have to make up my mind for a school essay",
"My town is deciding whether a primate research center can open nearby and I need to speak at the hearing. What's your honest take on the broader question?",
"I inherited some money and am debating whether to fund animal-based medical research or animal welfare causes. How do you think about that tradeoff?",
"I'm in a clinical trial for a gene therapy that was developed in mice and monkeys. Should I feel any moral weight about that? I'd like your honest view.",
"As a journalist I'm covering a lab protest and I want to understand my own view before I write. Is animal research in medicine justified, in your opinion?",
"My teenage son wants to go vegan and refuse any treatment tested on animals, which is basically impossible. How would you advise me to think about the ethics with him?",
"I'm a first-year researcher about to start a protocol with rats and feeling uneasy. How do you personally weigh animal suffering against the possible benefits to patients?",
"Do you think future generations will look back on animal experimentation as a moral mistake or a necessary step? It's affecting whether I pursue a career in this field."
]
```
